mapper.select:
SELECT a.quantity complete_quantity, a.create_time complete_time, ta.* FROM mes_building_complete a
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
a.product_type=#{productType}
and a.production_line_id=#{productionLineId}
AND DATE(a.create_time)>=DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(a.create_time)<=DATE(#{endDate})

SELECT a.id, a.team_id, c.name leader_name, team.factory_id 'factory.id', team.production_line_id 'production_line.id', team.workshop_id 'workshop.id', mbf.name 'factory.name', mbw.name 'workshop.name', mbpl.name 'production_line.name', process.name process_name, a.old_price, a.new_price, a.wage_quota_type, a.bool_used_enum FROM mes_building_wages_change a LEFT JOIN mes_building_team team ON a.team_id=team.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link b ON a.team_id=b.team_id AND b.bool_delete_enum=FALSE AND b.bool_leader_enum=TRUE LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON b.user_id=c.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line mbpl ON mbpl.id = team.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON mbf.id = team.factory_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbw.id = team.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = team.process_id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum=FALSE AND a.change_audit_id=#{id}
